The '''Caravanserai Arms Bazaar''' is one of four orcish workshops used for trade. Weapons, armor and ammo can be bought or sold here. Copper coins may be exchanged for silver or silver coins for gold using 5,000 coins at a 25:5:2 rate.

== Sold ==
* [[Metal]] [[weaponry]] (500 silver coins)
* [[Metal]] shields (500 silver coins)
* [[Metal]] helms (500 silver coins)
* [[Metal]] body armor (1,000 silver coins)

== Bought ==
* 50 [[cv:Bronze|bronze]] arrows (1,000 silver coins)
* 50 [[cv:Iron|iron]] arrows (1,000 gold coins)
* 5 [[cv:Bronze|Bronze]] [[cv:Ballista arrow|ballista arrows]] (2,000 silver coins)
* [[cv:Bronze|Bronze]] crossbows (1,000 gold coins)
* [[cv:Silver|Silver]] warhammers (2,000 gold coins)
* 6 pulleys (2,000 silver coins)
* 6 [[cv:Bronze|Bronze]] trap components (3,000 gold coins)
* [[cv:Steel|Steel]] katana (1,000 platinum coins)
* [[cv:Steel|Steel]] polehammer (1,000 platinum coins)
* [[cv:Steel|Steel]] battle axe (1,000 platinum coins)
* [[cv:Steel|Steel]] battle pick (1,000 platinum coins)
* [[Legion Auxilla]] blueprints (5,000 gold coins)
